attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Minnesota corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts); result.mn_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.mn_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Minnesota state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. MN generally conforms to IRC with some modifications.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Minnesota state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set mn_result.state_additions = 0.0; if mn_result.us_interest_income != 0.0 then set mn_result.state_additions = mn_result.state_additions + mn_result.us_interest_income; endif set mn_result.state_subtractions = 0.0; if mn_result.municipal_interest != 0.0 then set mn_result.state_subtractions = mn_result.state_subtractions + mn_result.municipal_interest; endif add (("Minnesota additions: $" + string value of (mn_result.state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (mn_result.state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /mn_result.state_additions xdef { mn_result.state_additions mn_result.us_interest_income f+ cvd /mn_result.state_additions xdef } {} mn_result.us_interest_income 0.0 f!= ifelse 0.0 cvd /mn_result.state_subtractions xdef { mn_result.state_subtractions mn_result.municipal_interest f+ cvd /mn_result.state_subtractions xdef } {} mn_result.municipal_interest 0.0 f!= ifelse "Minnesota additions: $" mn_result.state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat mn_result.state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Minnesota corporate income tax. Applies Minnesota flat rate (9.5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.mn_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Minnesota corporate tax (flat rate 9.5%); Apply Minnesota 9.5% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set mn_result.taxable_income = the maximum of (mn_result.apportioned_income + mn_result.state_additions - mn_result.state_subtractions) and (0.0); set mn_result.tax_liability = the maximum of (mn_result.taxable_income * mn_result.corp_tax_rate - mn_result.state_credits) and (0.0); set mn_result.refund_or_owed = mn_result.estimated_payments - mn_result.tax_liability; add "Minnesota taxable income: $" + string value of (mn_result.taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Minnesota tax liability (9.5%): $" + string value of (mn_result.tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: mn_result.apportioned_income mn_result.state_additions f+ mn_result.state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /mn_result.taxable_income xdef mn_result.taxable_income mn_result.corp_tax_rate fmul mn_result.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /mn_result.tax_liability xdef mn_result.estimated_payments mn_result.tax_liability f- cvd /mn_result.refund_or_owed xdef "Minnesota taxable income: $" mn_result.taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Minnesota tax liability (9.5%): $" mn_result.tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
